Course at a glance: Core ME curriculum (mechanics, dynamics, thermo, design) plus required thesis; robotics via 2.12 Intro to Robotics or the flexible 2-A track.
Student life: First-years must live on campus (20 halls). Halal: Maseeh dining hall stations plus Argana Falafel in the Student Center; musalla in W11.
Entry requirements: Holistic; no fixed grade cutoff or course list. SAT or ACT required (no cutoff or recommended scores); take by Nov 30 (Early Action) or Dec 31 (Regular Action).
English req: Not required; strongly recommended if you used English under 5 years or not at school. IELTS min 7, recommended 7.5.
Scholarship & portal: No merit scholarships — MIT meets 100% of demonstrated financial need with MIT Scholarship grants (never repaid).
Scholarship coverage: Need blind + meets 100% of demonstrated need for all, incl. international; MIT FAQ: 'one of only nine' US schools.
Scholarship competitiveness: The aid is guaranteed by policy once admitted — no separate scholarship contest.
How to get the scholarship: (1) Apply by 2027-01-04; (2) file CSS Profile (code 3514), upload parent tax/income docs to IDOC by aid deadline: 2026-11-30 (Early Action) or 2027-02-15 (Regular Action); (3) offer by email.
Money to show (visa): Bank proof meeting MIT's cost of attendance: USD 92,760 for 2026-27
Work rights after graduating: Post-study work permit 12 mo, plus 24 mo extension for STEM degrees = up to 3 yrs.
Recognised in Malaysia?: ABET-accredited (Course 2); the US is a Washington Accord signatory (basis for BEM registration). MQA eSISRAF lists MIT with a Science (BSc) row.
Notes: MIT says it is need blind and meets 100% of demonstrated need for all undergrads incl. international; aid never includes loans. Class of 2029: 4.6% admitted overall; intl 136 of 6,926.
Application requirements: Essay · 2 recommendation letters · Test: SAT or ACT

Course at a glance: 4-yr direct-honours BEng across 5 depts, blending design, control theory, programming and AI/ML/IoT/automation; hands-on projects and internships.
Student life: Kent Ridge campus; Makers@CDE and Tinkering Corner labs (3D printing, laser cutting); NUS RoboMaster team competes internationally.
Entry requirements: Common Engineering admission with ME and ESP; Maths required; Singapore A-Level profile BBB/C to AAA/A (10th-90th percentile, AY2025/26 offers)
English req: Not required — NUS asks A-Level applicants for no English test; IELTS/TOEFL optional to submit
Scholarship & portal: (1) MOE Tuition Grant, taken up on acceptance of the NUS offer; (2) ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship, via the NUS Applicant Portal application.
Scholarship coverage: MOE Tuition Grant cuts the fee from SGD 39,700 to SGD 18,050 a year (54.5% off), with a 3-year Singapore work bond.
Scholarship competitiveness: MOE Tuition Grant is broadly available (near-automatic for admitted international students who accept the bond) = low competitiveness.
How to get the scholarship: Apply for NUS admission; eligible ASEAN applicants are considered for the ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship through it, no separate form; shortlisted applicants are interviewed Jan-Jul.
Money to show (visa): ICA publishes no fixed amount; the Student's Pass follows NUS admission and fee payment
Work rights after graduating: No post-study work visa; the Tuition Grant bond requires 3 years working for a Singapore-registered company after graduation.
Recognised in Malaysia?: RMI is not on the IES Engineering Accreditation Board list (Dec 2025); BEng Mechanical Engineering is, from AY2007/08
Key deadline: 2027-02-17 (AY2027/28 international window: 16 Dec 2026 - 17 Feb 2027, per NUS Office of Admissions)
Notes: New programme from AY2025/26, so no graduates yet; admitted through the common Engineering pool shared with Mechanical Engineering; spans ME, BME, ChBE, ECE and MSE depts.

Course: Bachelor of Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering (Honours)
Course at a glance: 4-yr BEng(Hons) at Clayton: common first year, robotics and mechatronics specialisation from Yr2, 12 weeks of work experience required.
Student life: Large suburban Clayton campus in Melbourne with standout student teams (Motorsport, Nova Rover).
Entry requirements: GCE A Levels score of 10 for 2027 entry, with Maths and Chemistry or Physics
Scholarship & portal: Monash International Merit Scholarship — AUD 15,000 per year (2026 rate) toward tuition, paid each year until you finish, on academic merit.
Scholarship coverage: Partial: a fixed AUD 15,000/yr (25% of the AUD 59,600 fee); no full ride, no living stipend.
Scholarship competitiveness: Merit-based; 20 awards a year across all international undergraduate offer-holders; a 70% average each semester keeps it.
How to get the scholarship: No application: international undergraduates with a full unconditional Monash offer are considered automatically; awarded on academic achievement.
Money to show (visa): Student visa (subclass 500): AUD 29,710 living costs for 12 months, plus tuition fees
Work rights after graduating: Post-study work visa: 2 years after a bachelor degree (including honours)
Recognised in Malaysia?: Engineers Australia-accredited (Washington Accord), which BEM accepts for Graduate Engineer
How to apply: Direct online application to Monash (not VTAC)
Intake: 2027 (Jul realistic; Feb 2027 too early for A2 results)
Notes: Clayton campus hosts Monash Nova Rover, a student team building Mars rovers for the University Rover Challenge in Utah.

Course at a glance: 4-yr MEng: 2 yrs general engineering core, then specialise from Yr3 into disciplines incl. robotics/mechatronics via Info & Computer or Mech Eng.
Student life: Collegiate Cambridge; student-run Robotics Society and Formula Student team Full Blue Racing build robots and race cars in dept workshops.
Entry requirements: A*A*A at A-level incl Maths + Physics (plus Further Maths if offered); ESAT (Maths 1, Maths 2, Physics) + interview. Holistic selection.
English req: IELTS 7.5 overall (7.0 per element). Waived only for majority English-speaking countries; Malaysia is not one.
Scholarship & portal: Cambridge Trust scholarships (cambridgetrust.org) — the main international route — plus College awards and country-specific schemes.
Scholarship coverage: Mostly partial for international undergraduates (a means-tested fee contribution); full-cost awards are rare.
Scholarship competitiveness: Highly competitive and limited for undergraduates.
How to get the scholarship: Be offered a place, declare financial need and apply via the Cambridge Trust / College funding routes by their deadlines (means-tested + merit).
Money to show (visa): GBP 10,539 living (9 months at GBP 1,171, outside London) plus first-year course fee on the CAS
Work rights after graduating: UK Graduate visa: 18 months for applications from 1 Jan 2027; a Skilled Worker visa is needed to stay longer.
Recognised in Malaysia?: MEng accredited by Engineering Council and bodies incl. IMechE, IET, RAeS, depending on papers taken; CEng-accredited UK MEng is Washington Accord-recognised
How to apply: UCAS (+ college choice, ESAT admissions test + interview)
Notes: Progression to Yr3/4 needs min 2.ii; no standalone robotics degree, mechatronics via Info & Computer Eng / Mech Eng in Yr3-4. Total adds 4 yrs of College fee (2027-28 average GBP 14,047).
Application requirements: Personal statement · 1 recommendation letter · Interview · Test: ESAT
Admit rate: 15.2% of international applicants offered a place, 2025-26

Course: BEng - Global Talents in Science & Engineering (Zijing College), Mechanical Engineering major (English-taught)
Course at a glance: 4-yr, fully English-taught residential BEng hosted by Zijing College, Tsinghua's undergrad residential college.
Student life: Residential Zijing College on campus, with academics alongside student activities.
Entry requirements: Foreign passport, full-time high school certificate, transcripts or SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB results; holistic review plus a Comprehensive Assessment.
English req: IELTS/TOEFL required; no fixed minimum published (holistic)
Scholarship & portal: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC), the main full-ride route - apply Type A via the Chinese Embassy in Malaysia (agency 4581) on studyinchina.csc.edu.cn; NOT Type B via Tsinghua for undergrads.
Scholarship coverage: CSC full award: tuition, campus accommodation, monthly stipend and medical insurance. Airfare not included.
Scholarship competitiveness: Very competitive - Tsinghua is China's top university and CSC does not publish per-university award rates, so treat exact odds as unpublished.
How to get the scholarship: Separate from admission: apply for CSC Type A through the Chinese Embassy, listing Tsinghua first. Tsinghua's page gives a Nov 2026 to Apr 2027 window, set per country.
Money to show (visa): Bank statement for X1 student visa (modest)
Work rights after graduating: Work (Z) visa possible but hard for fresh grads; weak fit for Arif's stronger-currency migration goal
Recognised in Malaysia?: CEEAA accreditation not published for this English-taught Zijing programme; BEM relies on it.
Notes: Zijing College is Tsinghua's 1st English-taught residential college; ME sits alongside IST, civil eng & design science in one multidisciplinary STEAM curriculum. App fee RMB800 + RMB800/yr insurance.

Course at a glance: 4-yr BSE MAE degree; senior independent work/thesis capstone; robotics via elective courses + optional interdisciplinary Robotics minor.
Student life: An active, fast-growing Muslim community; residential-college dining, then eating clubs for upper years.
Entry requirements: Holistic review of transcript, teacher and counselor letters and essays; no minimum grades or GPA published
English req: TOEFL, IELTS Academic, Duolingo or PTE Academic if English is not your native language and school is not English-taught
Scholarship & portal: No merit scholarships; need-based grants (never repaid) replace loans and meet 100% of demonstrated need, apply via Princeton's own PFAA
Scholarship coverage: Need-blind for internationals; one of the few US schools that never caps international aid.
Scholarship competitiveness: Guaranteed once admitted, no separate contest. Gate is admission: 4.4% of all applicants (CDS 2025-26); 241 of 10,567 international applicants (2.3%)
How to get the scholarship: File Princeton's own PFAA (no CSS Profile) + parents' tax docs: due Nov 9 (Single-Choice Early Action) or Feb 1 (Regular Decision). Need-blind incl. internationals; no merit aid.
Work rights after graduating: 12 months post-study work + 24-month science post-study work extension = up to 3 yrs
Recognised in Malaysia?: MAE's mechanical and aerospace BSE programs are ABET-accredited; the USA is a Washington Accord signatory, the basis for BEM registration
Notes: Test-optional through fall 2027 entry; SAT/ACT required from 2027-28 cycle (fall 2028 entry) on. No dedicated robotics major - reached via MAE electives + Robotics minor.

Course at a glance: BS ME: shared core (structures, dynamics, thermo, design) + electives, not a formal track; robotics via ME320 and tech electives.
Student life: Four-year on-campus housing guarantee; Product Realization Lab makerspace and Stanford Robotics Club open to any undergrad, not just ME majors.
Entry requirements: Holistic review; SAT or ACT required; no minimum grades published
English req: No English test required (optional to self-report); fluency in English is a prerequisite for admission.
Scholarship & portal: No merit scholarships (athletic aside); need-based aid only. Request it on the admission application, then file the CSS Profile (school code 4704).
Scholarship coverage: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for every admitted student who requests aid, internationals included.
Scholarship competitiveness: Need-aware for internationals: an aid request is a factor in admission and international aid is limited. Admit rate 3.8% of all applicants.
How to get the scholarship: Tick the aid request on the admission application, then file the CSS Profile; ISAFA only if you cannot pay the Profile fee. Priority date 2027-02-15.
Money to show (visa): USD 97,545 (one year of funding, Stanford 2026-27 undergraduate budget)
Work rights after graduating: 12 months post-study work + 24-month science post-study work extension = up to 3 yrs.
Recognised in Malaysia?: ABET-accredited Mechanical Engineering BS; USA is a Washington Accord signatory, which supports BEM registration; MQA lists foreign degrees at mqa.gov.my.
Notes: No dedicated robotics/mechatronics degree or concentration at Stanford ME; robotics learned via electives, ME320, and student robotics clubs/labs.
Application requirements: Essay · 3 supplemental essays · 3 recommendation letters · Test: SAT or ACT

Course at a glance: 4-yr BEng (Hons) combining mechanical, control & software engineering; flexible first year, 60 days mandatory industry placement.
Student life: Large engineering-heavy campus 15 min from Sydney's eastern beaches; trimesters and big student teams.
Entry requirements: A-levels aggregate 16.0 (A*=6 to E=1, best 3-4 A2 subjects); assumed knowledge Mathematics Extension 1 and Physics
Scholarship & portal: International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (separate application on UNSW Scholarships portal); International Student Award (considered at admission)
Scholarship coverage: Scientia: full tuition or AUD 20,000 per year for the minimum program length; Student Award: 20% of tuition
Scholarship competitiveness: Scientia is awarded on academic achievement, leadership and extracurriculars; award numbers not published
How to get the scholarship: Scientia: apply on the UNSW Scholarships portal by the round closing date (Term 1 2027 round closed 30 Oct 2026). Student Award: after applying, submit a brief motivation statement if invited.
Money to show (visa): Student visa (subclass 500): first-year tuition + AUD 29,710 living costs + travel
Work rights after graduating: Post-study work visa: 2-3 yrs depending on qualification
Notes: Kensington campus; ChallEng industry projects, Robogals & Women in Engineering societies; optional Nuclear Engineering minor.

Course: SB Mechanical Engineering (ABET-accredited; mechatronics/robotics via SEAS)
Course at a glance: Standalone ABET-accredited SB Mechanical Eng (20 courses), distinct from AB/SB Engineering Sciences; covers mechatronics/robotics; declared end yr1.
Student life: First-years live in dorms in or next to Harvard Yard and eat together at Annenberg Hall.
Entry requirements: Holistic review, no fixed grade cutoff; SAT or ACT, school report, 2 teacher letters and essays
English req: No English test required for first-year applicants (optional to submit).
Scholarship & portal: Harvard is NEED-BLIND for all applicants incl. internationals and meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants, no loans. Requested via the CSS Profile + IDOC with the Common App.
Scholarship coverage: Full demonstrated need met with grants (never repaid), no loans.
Scholarship competitiveness: Aid is need-based and open to every admitted student; requesting aid does not affect admission.
How to get the scholarship: File the CSS Profile, then upload parent income documents to IDOC by Nov 1 (Restrictive Early Action) or Feb 1 (Regular Decision).
Money to show (visa): No fixed amount; student visa form with aid award letter or bank documents
Work rights after graduating: 12 months post-study work for any degree; 24-month science post-study work extension if the degree is on the US science-degree list.
Recognised in Malaysia?: SB Mechanical Engineering is ABET-accredited + USA is a Washington Accord signatory - supports BEM. The AB Engineering Sciences track is NOT accredited.
Notes: Aid is 100% need-based, no merit scholarships (incl. int'l applicants). Robotics is a track within ME, not standalone; access to Wyss Institute and Microrobotics Lab.
Application requirements: Essay · 5 supplemental essays · 3 recommendation letters · Test: SAT

Course at a glance: 4-yr MEng (5-yr with industry/abroad placement); robotics/mechatronics woven in via core Mechatronics 1-3 modules, not a separate stream.
Student life: South Kensington campus on the Exhibition Road museum row by Hyde Park; 380+ clubs incl. Robotics Society and Formula Racing; Ethos gym on site.
Entry requirements: A*A*A or A*AAA, with A* in Maths and A/A* in Physics; ESAT (Maths 1, Maths 2, Physics) required; interview for shortlisted applicants.
English req: IELTS 6.5, min 6.0 each (Imperial standard level); or SPM English 1119 grade A. No waiver for schooling in English
Scholarship & portal: Imperial Inspires Scholarship (GBP 15,000/yr, via UCAS + optional statement by 5 Feb 2027) + Khazanah Global Scholarship (full; Imperial approved). GREAT Scholarships are postgraduate-only.
Scholarship coverage: Imperial Inspires: GBP 15,000/yr every year (GBP 60,000 over 4 yrs), overseas-only, partial not a full ride.
Scholarship competitiveness: Imperial Inspires: 150 awards for 2027 entry across Engineering, Natural Sciences, Medicine and Business; entry requirements must be met.
How to get the scholarship: Apply to Imperial via UCAS by 13 Jan 2027; applicants meeting entry requirements are invited to submit an optional 250-word statement by 5 Feb 2027. Decisions by 30 Apr 2027.
Money to show (visa): Student visa: GBP 13,761 living (9 months x GBP 1,529 London) plus first-year tuition
Work rights after graduating: UK Graduate Route: 18 months for applications from 1 Jan 2027 (2 years if applied by 31 Dec 2026), then a Skilled Worker visa is needed.
Recognised in Malaysia?: MEng accredited by IMechE for the UK Engineering Council (CEng route); UK and Malaysia (BEM) are Washington Accord signatories; year-abroad not accredited.
Notes: No dedicated robotics stream: mechatronics is built into the core Mechanical Engineering curriculum. ESAT required.
Application requirements: Personal statement · 1 recommendation letter · Interview · Test: ESAT

Course at a glance: 4-year BEng blending mechanical, electrical, mechatronics & AI courses; accelerated 3.5-year track for high performers.
Student life: NTU's 'smart campus' runs driverless buses & campus-wide robotics; MAE Robotics Club, RoboMaster Society, and a Makerspace at The Arc.
Entry requirements: A-Level H2 Maths plus Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computing; UK A-Level needs at least 4 subjects at A2 in one sitting
English req: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, 6.5 Writing, 6.5 Speaking; TOEFL iBT 90 or PTE 55 also accepted
Scholarship & portal: NTU ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship, form linked at the end of the NTU admission application; MOE Tuition Grant (SGD 18,050/yr for ASEAN, 3-year Singapore work bond)
Scholarship coverage: NTU ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship = full subsidised tuition (after the MOE grant)
Scholarship competitiveness: MOE Tuition Grant is open to admitted international students who sign the 3-year bond; ASEAN Scholarship award statistics are not published
How to get the scholarship: Submit the NTU admission application, then the scholarship form linked at its end: essay up to 250 words, photo, teacher referee appraisal. Interviews run March to May.
Money to show (visa): ICA Student's Pass page publishes no minimum funds amount
Work rights after graduating: No post-study work visa; the Tuition Grant bond requires 3 years working for a Singapore entity after graduating.
Recognised in Malaysia?: NTU BEng programmes are accredited by IES Singapore (Washington Accord signatory); IES list does not name Robotics
Notes: Fee shown is ASEAN with Tuition Grant, AY2026/27, incl. 9% GST; without grant SGD 36,350-40,600. QS 2026 Mechanical, Aeronautical & Manufacturing: 5th.

Course at a glance: ABET-accredited BS Mechanical Engineering plus a 7-course Robotics minor most finish in 4 yrs; Mechatronics (ME430) is required for all ME majors.
Student life: Small Terre Haute campus; 90+ clubs, MakerLab, and robotics teams compete in Intelligent Ground Vehicle and MATE-ROV competitions.
Entry requirements: Holistic review, no fixed grade cutoff. Coursework: 4 yrs math, 4 English, 3 lab science (bio, chem, physics), 2 social science. SAT/ACT optional.
Student grades: A*A*A*A* predicted (Maths, Further Maths, Physics, Chemistry)
English req: IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each); TOEFL iBT 88 (20 each) or 4.5 new scale; Duolingo 110; PTE 59. Waived: SAT EBRW 500+/ACT Eng 21+
Scholarship & portal: Merit scholarship (every applicant); FIRST/VEX USD 10,000/yr (Feb 1); Competition Teams USD 1,000-2,500/yr (Apr 1, 2026-27 award). Intl eligibility not stated. rose-hulman.edu portal.
Scholarship coverage: Merit: amount unpublished. FIRST/VEX USD 10,000/yr; Competition Teams USD 1,000-2,500/yr. Intl eligibility not stated.
Scholarship competitiveness: No award-rate statistics published. Intl students fund USD 45,000/yr on average; full-tuition awards 'extremely limited'; cannot meet full need.
How to get the scholarship: 1) Apply by Early Action Nov 1 or Regular Feb 1; merit is offered to every applicant. 2) If admitted: FIRST/VEX form by Feb 1; Competition Teams interest form by Apr 1.
Money to show (visa): Affidavit of support + bank statement (under 6 months old) for the school's cost of attendance less aid
Work rights after graduating: 12 months work after graduating, plus 24 more: mechanical engineering is on the US STEM degree list (CIP 14.1901). Intl placement not published.
Recognised in Malaysia?: ME is ABET-accredited. ABET is a Washington Accord signatory, the accord behind BEM recognition.
How to apply: Common App or GoRose App (Rose-Hulman's own form)
Notes: Robotics is a 7-course minor on the ME degree, not a degree. Annual tuition is the combined tuition-and-fees line. Intl students also pay USD 1,191/yr health insurance, not in cost columns.

Course: Mechanical Engineering, BSME (Boston) with Robotics Minor (co-op)
Course at a glance: BSME takes 4 yrs with 2 six-month co-ops, or 5 yrs with 3; the Robotics minor (5 courses: ME, EECE, CS) is run by the ECE dept and added on top.
Student life: Urban Boston campus; in 2022 the NURobotics club had 470 members building eight robots, called one of the largest engineering clubs on campus.
Entry requirements: Holistic; no minimum grades published. SAT/ACT test-optional. Needs physics, chemistry, precalculus. A-Level predicted grades accepted; final results required.
Student grades: A*A*A*A* predicted (Maths, Further Maths, Physics, Chemistry)
English req: No minimum; IELTS, TOEFL iBT, DET or PTE (admits' IELTS 7.5-8.0). Waiver: 4 straight yrs English-medium schooling.
Scholarship & portal: Merit scholarships (amount varies); Stamps Scholars via John Martinson Honors (invite). No need-based aid for internationals. The admission application is the scholarship application.
Scholarship coverage: Merit scholarships vary in amount and do not cover the full cost of attendance (USD 98,322/yr)
Scholarship competitiveness: No statistics published; described as very competitive. Admission is need-aware for internationals.
How to get the scholarship: (1) Apply by 2027-01-01 (Regular Decision) via Common App or Coalition; (2) submit the Declaration and Certification of Finances; (3) no separate form: merit is decided with admission.
Money to show (visa): Funds for one full academic year (tuition, housing, food, personal); DCF form at application, then proof via myOGS
Work rights after graduating: Post-study work permit 12 months + 24-month science extension (36 total); BSME code 14.1901 is on the US STEM list. Co-op needs school work authorization.
Recognised in Malaysia?: BS Mechanical Eng is ABET-accredited (Northeastern page) -> Washington Accord -> BEM route. eSISRAF lists the Boston BS; BEM status not checked.
Key deadline: 2027-01-01 (Regular Decision; Early Action 2026-11-01; Early Decision I 2026-11-01, Early Decision II 2027-01-01)
Notes: Co-op is optional, but 90%+ of Mechanical & Industrial Eng undergrads do one. Job offers after co-op are shown in dept student stories; no conversion rate is published.

Course: BSc (Mechatronics Systems major) + Master of Mechatronics Engineering
Course at a glance: 3-yr BSc then a 2-yr master's (the Melbourne Model), 5 years in total for the accredited qualification.
Student life: Lively Parkville campus beside inner-city Melbourne; cultural and walkable rather than outdoorsy.
Entry requirements: A-levels incl Maths for BSc entry; Master needs BSc (Mechatronics Systems) grade average >=65%
Scholarship & portal: Melbourne International Excellence Scholarship (Undergraduate): considered automatically when you apply for the BSc.
Scholarship coverage: 20% of BSc tuition fees, for the whole BSc (2027 entry onwards).
Scholarship competitiveness: At least 140 awards; given to the highest course entry scores.
How to get the scholarship: No separate application: apply for the BSc. Outcome within 5 working days of a course offer; unsuccessful applicants are not told.
Money to show (visa): Student visa (subclass 500): AUD 29,710 living costs for 12 months, plus tuition fees
Work rights after graduating: post-study work visa; master's = longer PSW eligibility; strong AUD
Recognised in Malaysia?: Engineers Australia-accredited via the Master of Mechatronics Engineering (Washington Accord)
How to apply: Direct online application to the University (not VTAC)
Intake: 2027 (Jul/S2 realistic; Feb/S1 2027 too early for A2 results)
Notes: Melbourne Model: 3-yr BSc major + 2-yr Master needed for Engineers Australia accreditation (5 yrs total); a BSc grade average of 65% guarantees an international fee place in the Master.

Warnings: Scholarship gap: no need-based aid for international undergraduates — clashes with his #1 priority.
Course: BS Mechanical Engineering (+ Robotics Institute minor)
Course at a glance: BS Mechanical Engineering, flexible curriculum; pairs with RI's Robotics Minor (controls, kinematics, 2 electives) for a robotics track.
Student life: Pittsburgh campus, 350+ clubs incl. robotics/engineering teams; CMU's Robotics Institute pioneered robotics research and education.
Entry requirements: Holistic review; 4 yrs maths (calculus encouraged), 1 yr each chemistry, physics, biology; essays; SAT, ACT or equivalent scores
English req: IELTS 7.5 overall; TOEFL iBT 5 overall (exams from 21 Jan 2026; 102 for earlier exams); Duolingo 135
Scholarship & portal: No CMU institutional aid for international undergraduates; only DACA students and a small number from specific countries qualify (CMU Student Financial Services)
Scholarship coverage: None realistically available — no need-based or merit aid for international undergraduates. External sponsors only.
Scholarship competitiveness: N/A — there is no CMU aid to compete for as an international undergrad.
How to get the scholarship: No CMU route. Funding comes from external Malaysian sponsors (JPA, MARA, Yayasan) or private scholarships, applied for separately. Full cost of attendance is USD 93,614 a year (2026-27).
Money to show (visa): No fixed US minimum; CMU's cost of attendance sets the student visa form figure: USD 93,614 (2026-27)
Work rights after graduating: 12 months post-study work after graduating, plus a 24-month science post-study work extension for a science degree = up to 3 yrs.
Recognised in Malaysia?: ABET-accredited BS Mechanical Engineering; USA is a Washington Accord signatory, the route to Board of Engineers Malaysia registration. MQA: mqa.gov.my.
Notes: Robotics Minor needs 2.5 QPA, max 2 courses double-counted with ME major; CMU founded the field's first Robotics Institute (1979).
Application requirements: Essay · 3 supplemental essays · 2 recommendation letters · Test: SAT, ACT, IB, AP or A-Level
